exact_statement: For every finite Boolean sign f and fixed nonempty proper ORIGINAL coordinate block A, let a(g) be minimum influence in the full finite affine-input/output-character orbit of each complete physical child, rho_A=E[I(g)-a(g)], Q_A=sum_{i in A}Inf_i(f), L_A=H(f)-E H(g), and S_A*=E[K a(g)-H(g)]. Every affine input map x_A=P y_A+b,x_C=Q y_A+R y_C+c with invertible P,R, together with any output character, preserves L_A,S_A* and satisfies Qprime_A+rhoprime_A-Delta=Q_A+rho_A, where Delta=I(fprime)-I(f). In each matched child, every cheap-parity threshold space is transported by R inverse, and its quotient rank modulo ANY transported previously booked parity subspace is identical. Thus the SAME full-terminal compensated signed bank is invariant, for all real K; query-compatible preprocessing supplies no net additional influence funding or new independent quotient ranks. Chosen resets have the same property when transported by conjugation. Genuine least-essential-dimensional positive K-witnesses with K>=0 have S_A*>=0; physical ratio criticality alone does not imply it. On every k>=2 activated quadratic F_k, an explicit query-preserving shear adds Delta=p/4 to the apparent query-plus-release, with rho unchanged atp/4; the compensation cancels exactly. Arbitrary changes of the original partition are excluded and the three-bit point-defect guard violates the broader invariance.
